description: Auto-discover Prefect deployments and emit one triggerable Dagster asset per deployment, with prefect_flow_run's full observability (forward_termination, stream_logs, stream_artifacts) applied uniformly. check_names and Dagster-side scheduling are explicit, per-deployment opt-ins via assets_by_name. StateBackedComponent — discovery cached to disk.

outputs.description: One triggerable Dagster asset per discovered Prefect deployment. See README for what each materialization does.

stream_logs.label: Stream Logs
stream_logs.description: Forward each deployment's own Prefect logs into the Dagster run log while waiting. Applies uniformly to every discovered deployment.

stream_artifacts.label: Stream Artifacts
stream_artifacts.description: Forward each deployment's Prefect artifacts as AssetObservation events. Applies uniformly. Required if any assets_by_name entry sets check_names.

assets_by_name.label: Assets By Name
assets_by_name.description: Per-deployment overrides keyed by 'flow_name/deployment_name': key, group_name, description, deps, metadata, tags, kinds, owners, check_names, schedule. Nothing here applies globally — see README.

auto_schedule.label: Auto Schedule
auto_schedule.description: Master switch for Dagster-side scheduling. A deployment only gets a schedule if it's ALSO named in assets_by_name.<name>.schedule: true — never inferred from Prefect's own schedule state.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: Watch ALL discovered deployments for completions triggered outside Dagster and emit an AssetObservation on the matching asset.
